source: Local production-build companion screenshots at desktop/mobile viewport sizes, using synthetic fixtures; not hosted Preview screenshots.
privacy_review: Visually inspected: synthetic aggregate workforce and staffing targets only. No private user content, credentials, absolute paths or embedded metadata.

assumptions.group: Business unit Operations (OPS), across all countries and levels; not job family.
assumptions.supply: Existing runScenarioModel with BU current headcount 100 and stored Baseline points 100 in October and 105 in November 2026. FTE 80/84 is not used in the gap. Baseline assumptions: zero growth, inflation, attrition and productivity hiring reduction; 100% fill.
assumptions.target: Explicit 110 people for November only. Initially blank, never seeded from engine target_headcount.
assumptions.gap: 110 required people minus 105 projected people equals 5 people short. No demand curve is generated.
assumptions.source_limitation: Configured-source GET returned HTTP 500 in executor. Actual source availability has not been verified; UI rejects unavailable or mismatched sources.
